caption: An empty playground swing is given one push and left alone, and it keeps going back and forth on its own before gradually dying down.

sa.check: An empty playground swing is present.
The swing is given one push and then left alone.
It keeps going back and forth on its own.
It is pushed once and nothing touches it again.
The push comes first, then the free swinging, then the dying down.

pc.expect: Each arc carries the seat a little less high than the one before, and the swing never rises above the arc the push gave it.
pc.fail: An arc carries the seat higher than the one before it with nothing touching the swing; or the arcs hold exactly the same height and then the swing stops dead; or the swinging builds up on its own.

pc.expect: The swing moves because of the one push; nothing else touches it, and it changes only by dying down.
pc.fail: The swing gets a fresh shove with nothing visible touching it; or it halts at the end of an arc and hangs there; or it starts up again after hanging still.

pc.expect: The seat hangs below its chains and travels along an arc, moving quickest at the bottom and slowest at the ends.
pc.fail: The seat rises above the height of the crossbar; or it stays out sideways at the end of an arc instead of swinging back; or it moves quickest at the top of its arc.

pc.expect: The chains stay taut and straight and the seat hangs from them, the two moving as one.
pc.fail: A chain bunches slack while the seat is swinging out; or a chain grows longer as the swing rises; or the seat swings while the chains hang still.

pc.expect: One seat on its chains keeps its number and shape and stays clear of the frame.
pc.fail: The seat vanishes or a second swing appears; or a chain comes away from the bar and the seat keeps swinging; or the seat passes through a chain or through the frame.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The swing's colour, the frame and the playground behind stay the same.
pc.fail: The seat changes colour or shape; or the frame changes height between frames; or the ground below rearranges.
